dashboard.section_branding_desc: The logo appears in the site header, footer and dashboard; the icon appears in the browser tab.
dashboard.hint.brand_mark_star: Square PNG or WebP with a transparent background, up to 2 MB.
dashboard.hint.brand_favicon: Square PNG or ICO (e.g. 512×512), up to 1 MB. If empty, the logo is used.
dashboard.hint.donation_categories: Shown to donors on the donate and gift pages. Key in lowercase English without spaces (e.g. orphans). Clear the key and name to remove a type. "general" is required and cannot be removed.
dashboard.pages_cards_hint: Add a card by filling an empty row; remove one by clearing its Arabic title. Up to :max cards; save to get more empty rows.
dashboard.site_texts_plural_hint: This text changes with the count; edit each form separately.
